'''Rakatan fighter''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] during the [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]].<ref name="DotJ:FW1" />
